title: pitwall web protocol 1
description: One frame of the web protocol (docs/web-protocol.md). Uses only the keywords internal/web/schema_test.go checks.

subscribeSessions.description: Get the session list now and its changes after.

listSessions.description: The session list once; archived chats when archived is true.

subscribe.description: Get a chat's deltas after seq `after`, then every new one. Also the resync.

after.description: The last seq the client holds; 0 for a snapshot.

read.description: A chat's deltas after seq `after` once.

after.description: The last seq the client holds; 0 for a snapshot.

fakeStartFailure.description: Only scripted fake providers use this per-start failure, e.g. missing-cli. Real providers ignore it.

provider.description: Another provider than the chat's switches the chat to it.

import.description: Stores an old aide session as an archived chat. Answers data.imported: false when the id is a live chat or one pitwall archived, which it leaves as they are.

sessionId.description: aide's session id, which becomes the chat id.

listProjects.description: The repos of the open tabs.

setJev.description: aide hands over its TypeSafe key, consent list and Jev gate settings for the chats it starts. Only a client that says hello as aide may send it; the daemon keeps it in memory and never sends the key back.

apiKey.description: The TypeSafe key; empty or left out for none.

disabledRoots.description: Workspace roots where the user turned TypeSafe processing off.

jevGateOverrides.description: One layer of aide's JevGateOverrides. Only toolGate applies to a pitwall chat.

readUsage.description: Plan limits, and tokens and cost by day and session, as Settings, Usage shows them.

days.description: The window ending today, 1 to 90 days; 30 when left out.

result.description: The answer to the command with the same id.

imported.description: import: false when the id was a live chat or one pitwall archived, left as it is.

text.description: prPrompt: the message, "" with nothing to send.

error.description: A frame the server cannot tie to a command.

sessionsChanged.description: Chats added or updated, and ids of chats removed.

deltas.description: ChatDeltas: a new base when snapshot is set (seq is its seq), then deltas in seq order.

removed.description: A subscribed chat was archived or deleted; its subscription ended.

chat.description: model.Chat: one entry of the session list.

recentPrompt.description: First prompt excerpt, at most 500 Unicode code points; optional for older chats.

project.description: The tabs that share a repo root.

planUsage.description: What readUsage answers. Costs are at the API's list prices of pricesAsOf and count priced models only.

showCost.description: [usage] show_cost: whether to show the costs.

days.description: One per day of the window, oldest first.

sessions.description: The window's sessions with the most tokens, at most 10.

sessionId.description: The agent's own session id, not a chat id.

unpriced.description: Tokens of models without a price.

planLimit.description: One plan limit as its agent last reported it.

profile.description: The account's profile, "" for the default.

name.description: Codex's name for a model's own limit, "" for the agent's main one.

used.description: Percent, 0 to 100, as reported: a window whose reset has passed is unused now.

set.description: A partial snapshot of patchable keys.

reviewThreads.description: The unresolved review threads and change requests of the chat's pull request.

prPrompt.description: pitwall's message asking the chat's agent to fix its pull request's failed checks or address its review.

mergePR.description: Merges the chat's pull request by [git] merge_method.

comment.description: A review comment, or a change request's text.

line.description: 0 when the thread is on the file, not a line.

more.description: Comments on GitHub past the ones listed.

pr.description: model.PR: the pull request of the chat's tab's branch, as pitwall's poll last saw it.
